info.title: CNBC Web Market Data API
info.description: Observed, undocumented, read-only web endpoints operated by CNBC for quote-page data. They are not a supported developer API: request headers may be required by the CDN, persisted-query hashes may rotate, fields are display-formatted strings, and availability or schema may change without notice.

get.summary: Get display-formatted quotes for one or more symbols
get.description: Returns CNBC quote-cache records. A browser-like User-Agent and CNBC Referer were required in a reproducible 2026-08-10 request; the same request without them received HTTP 403 from Akamai. Multiple symbols must be separated with `|`; a comma-separated `AAPL,MSFT` request was treated as one invalid symbol and returned `code: 1`. Numeric market values are generally locale-formatted strings (for example `313.33`, `32,322,778`, `4.573T`, and `+0.29%`), so consumers must not assume JSON numbers. Delayed/real-time status and attribution are conveyed by fields such as `source`, `provider`, and `realTime`.

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: One CNBC symbol, or multiple symbols separated by a vertical bar (`|`). Examples include equities (`AAPL`), indices (`.SPX`), and multiple symbols (`AAPL|MSFT`). This is a wire-format string, not an OpenAPI exploded array.

schema.description: One CNBC symbol, or multiple symbols separated by a vertical bar (`|`). Examples include equities (`AAPL`), indices (`.SPX`), and multiple symbols (`AAPL|MSFT`). This is a wire-format string, not an OpenAPI exploded array.

parameters.name: requestMethod
parameters.description: Observed client mode. `quick` is used by the quote-page request.

schema.description: Observed client mode. `quick` is used by the quote-page request.

parameters.name: partnerId
parameters.description: Observed CNBC partner identifier; `2` was verified, but this is not a public client credential or documented contract.

schema.description: Observed CNBC partner identifier; `2` was verified, but this is not a public client credential or documented contract.

200.description: JSON envelope containing one record per requested symbol. Unknown symbols are represented in the same HTTP 200 envelope by a record containing the requested `symbol` and non-zero `code` (observed: `1`), rather than by an HTTP error.

get.x-pontx-stability-note: Undocumented display-data endpoint behind Akamai. Browser-like User-Agent and CNBC Referer were necessary in the verification environment; throttling, blocking, field changes, and formatted-string values remain likely.

get.summary: Get CNBC quote chart data with the persisted query
get.description: Executes an undocumented persisted GraphQL query. The recorded SHA-256 hash was accepted on 2026-08-10, but the documented sample variables produced a successful envelope whose chart fields were null. Treat this endpoint as experimental: the variable contract and persisted hash are frontend implementation details and may rotate independently.

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: URL-encoded JSON object. The shown shape is observed but not a stable public contract.

schema.description: URL-encoded JSON object. The shown shape is observed but not a stable public contract.

parameters.name: extensions
parameters.description: URL-encoded Apollo persisted-query descriptor. The hash can rotate with CNBC frontend deployments.

schema.description: URL-encoded Apollo persisted-query descriptor. The hash can rotate with CNBC frontend deployments.

200.description: GraphQL response; HTTP 200 may still contain null data or an `errors` array.
